name: uccif
description: Install once, then in any repository: a self-updating code index, LSP config, task memory, token reporting, project docs with drift detection, and a token-saving workflow. Never blocks.

reply_language.title: Reply language

token_report.title: Token line after each turn
token_report.description: Show one line with real token usage (read from the transcript) after each reply.
